name: Poslednee mgnovenie
source:
Have you ever wondered what would happen if you had the chance to change the past? If you could go back and say the right words - or maybe just do something you didn’t have the courage to before?
The protagonist of this story has been asking himself those questions for a long time, but still hasn’t found the answer. If you’re searching too, you’ll have to walk this difficult road with him.

What kind of adventure awaits you, you ask? The answer is simple - saving the multiverse, one last time.

You’ve probably heard the theory that there are endless versions of our world out there. Well, it’s true. And believe me - every one of them matters. Every world is worth fighting for, no matter how different it may be.

No, this isn’t a rewritten tale of Semyon, and it’s not just another "accidental traveler" story. This time, you’ll live out the final days of a fading summer through the eyes of a very familiar character - the head of the cybernetics club, a young, promising scientist, and simply a good guy - Shurik.

But how can you save the world if you can’t even help your own friends? That’s why Shurik will face not one, but two challenges: not only to protect the peace of space and time, but to learn how to live in the world he’s meant to save.

[spoiler] The story takes place after the events of [url=/v57714]Struny vremeni[/url], but in a parallel universe. And only over time do these two stories begin to intersect, leading to the grand finale of the trilogy.[/spoiler]
translation:
你有没有想过如果你有机会改变过去会发生什么？如果你可以回去说正确的话 - 或者也许只是做一些你以前没有勇气做的事情？
这个故事的主人公一直在问自己这些问题，但仍然没有找到答案。如果你也在寻找，你就得和他一起走这条艰难的路。

你问，什么样的冒险在等待着你？答案很简单——最后一次拯救多元宇宙。

你可能听说过这样的理论：我们的世界有无穷无尽的版本。嗯，这是真的。相信我——它们中的每一个都很重要。每个世界都值得为之奋斗，无论它有多么不同。

不，这不是谢苗的重写故事，也不仅仅是另一个“偶然的旅行者”的故事。这一次，你将通过一个非常熟悉的角色的眼睛度过一个逐渐消逝的夏天的最后几天——控制论俱乐部的负责人、一位年轻、有前途的科学家，而且还是一个好人——舒里克。

但如果你连自己的朋友都无法帮助，你怎么能拯救世界呢？这就是为什么舒里克将面临的不是一个挑战，而是两个挑战：不仅要保护时空的和平，还要学会如何生活在他打算拯救的世界中。

[spoiler]故事发生在[url=/v57714]Struny vremeni[/url]事件之后，但发生在平行宇宙中。只有随着时间的推移，这两个故事才开始交叉，导致三部曲的大结局。[/spoiler]
